mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the threads to the platelet plug was most worthwhile: it brought the two separate parts together and showed how the leak stops.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the initial cut was the least interesting step because it was an obvious setup for the repair.

surprise.text: I noticed that stopping the bleeding and healing the skin are different things: the surface was still open after the clot formed.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary. The pictures and enzyme label gave a clear purpose for each pairing.

continue.text: I would choose to continue, because the still-open skin makes me curious how the surface heals after bleeding stops.
